Related, not the programme: KTH has no bachelor's programme titled Computer Science. The closest in subject is the Swedish-taught Civilingenjör Datateknik 300 hp (an integrated five-year engineering programme; first three years a common kandidat track) and the only English-taught bachelor is BSc Information and Communication Technology (180 ECTS). Both are related.
